## Security checklist
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or customer data added
- [ ] Content from documents or connectors is treated as untrusted
- [ ] Actions run with the caller's own permissions; errors fail closed
- [ ] No hard-coded colours (tokens only) and no hard-coded user-facing strings (i18n)
- [ ] Arabic RTL and light/dark themes checked if UI changed
- [ ] New dependencies have their licence recorded in NOTICE.md or the licence register
